name: Auto Computation - Admin Employees Management (List, Add & Edit)

parameters.query:
={{ $json.action === 'CREATE' ? `
-- 1. Create New Employee
DO \$\$
DECLARE
  v_emp_id VARCHAR(50);
  v_max_id INT;
BEGIN
  -- Ensure personal_email column exists
  ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS personal_email VARCHAR(255);

  IF '` + ($json.body.customId || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `' <> '' THEN
    v_emp_id := '` + ($json.body.customId || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `';
  ELSE
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SUBSTRING(id FROM 5)::INT), 24) + 1 INTO v_max_id FROM employees WHERE id ~ '^EMP-[0-9]+$';
    v_emp_id := 'EMP-' || LPAD(COALESCE(v_max_id, 25)::TEXT, 3, '0');
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO employees (
    id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    personal_email,
    password_hash,
    phone,
    designation,
    joining_date,
    employment_type,
    work_location,
    role,
    salary,
    is_active
  ) VALUES (
    v_emp_id,
    '` + ($json.body.firstName || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
    '` + ($json.body.lastName || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
    LOWER('` + ($json.body.email || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `'),
    NULLIF(LOWER('` + ($json.body.personalEmail || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `'), ''),
    crypt('` + ($json.body.password || 'Auto@2026').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `', gen_salt('bf', 8)),
    '` + ($json.body.phone || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
    '` + ($json.body.designation || 'Staff').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
    '` + ($json.body.joiningDate || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]).trim() + `'::DATE,
    '` + ($json.body.employmentType || 'Full-time').trim() + `',
    '` + ($json.body.workLocation || 'Chinar Park, Teghoria, Kolkata (In-Office)').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
    '` + (($json.body.role || 'EMPLOYEE').toUpperCase() === 'ADMIN' ? 'ADMIN' : 'EMPLOYEE') + `',
    ` + (parseFloat($json.body.salary) || 0) + `,
    TRUE
  );

  -- Seed Leave Balances for 2026
  INSERT INTO leave_balances (employee_id, leave_type, year, label, total, used) VALUES
    (v_emp_id, 'CASUAL', EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 'Casual Leave', 12.0, 0.0),
    (v_emp_id, 'SICK', EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 'Sick Leave', 12.0, 0.0),
    (v_emp_id, 'EARNED', EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 'Earned Leave', 15.0, 0.0),
    (v_emp_id, 'HALF_DAY', EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 'Half Day Leave', 6.0, 0.0)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
END \$\$;

SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.first_name AS "firstName",
  e.last_name AS "lastName",
  e.email,
  e.personal_email AS "personalEmail",
  e.phone,
  e.designation,
  e.joining_date::TEXT AS "joiningDate",
  e.employment_type AS "employmentType",
  e.work_location AS "workLocation",
  e.role,
  e.salary::FLOAT AS salary,
  e.is_active AS "isActive",
  e.avatar_url AS "avatarUrl"
FROM employees e
WHERE LOWER(e.email) = LOWER('` + ($json.body.email || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `')
LIMIT 1;
` : $json.action === 'UPDATE' ? `
-- 2. Update Existing Employee
ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS personal_email VARCHAR(255);

UPDATE employees
SET
  first_name = '` + ($json.body.firstName || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  last_name = '` + ($json.body.lastName || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  email = LOWER('` + ($json.body.email || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `'),
  personal_email = COALESCE(NULLIF('` + ($json.body.personalEmail || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `', ''), personal_email),
  phone = '` + ($json.body.phone || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  designation = '` + ($json.body.designation || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  employment_type = '` + ($json.body.employmentType || 'Full-time').trim() + `',
  work_location = '` + ($json.body.workLocation || 'Chinar Park, Teghoria, Kolkata (In-Office)').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  role = '` + (($json.body.role || 'EMPLOYEE').toUpperCase() === 'ADMIN' ? 'ADMIN' : 'EMPLOYEE') + `',
  salary = ` + (parseFloat($json.body.salary) || 0) + `,
  is_active = ` + ($json.body.isActive === false ? 'FALSE' : 'TRUE') + `,
  ` + (($json.body.newPassword && $json.body.newPassword.trim().length > 0) ? `password_hash = crypt('` + $json.body.newPassword.trim().replace(/'/g, "''") + `', gen_salt('bf', 8)),` : '') + `
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = '` + ($json.body.employeeId || '').trim() + `';

SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.first_name AS "firstName",
  e.last_name AS "lastName",
  e.email,
  e.personal_email AS "personalEmail",
  e.phone,
  e.designation,
  e.joining_date::TEXT AS "joiningDate",
  e.employment_type AS "employmentType",
  e.work_location AS "workLocation",
  e.role,
  e.salary::FLOAT AS salary,
  e.is_active AS "isActive",
  e.avatar_url AS "avatarUrl"
FROM employees e
WHERE id = '` + ($json.body.employeeId || '').trim() + `'
LIMIT 1;
` : `
-- 3. List All Employees with Today Attendance Status
ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS personal_email VARCHAR(255);

SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.first_name AS "firstName",
  e.last_name AS "lastName",
  e.email,
  e.personal_email AS "personalEmail",
  e.phone,
  e.designation,
  e.joining_date::TEXT AS "joiningDate",
  e.employment_type AS "employmentType",
  e.work_location AS "workLocation",
  e.role,
  e.salary::FLOAT AS salary,
  e.is_active AS "isActive",
  e.avatar_url AS "avatarUrl",
  json_build_object(
    'checkIn', a.check_in,
    'checkOut', a.check_out,
    'status', COALESCE(a.status, 'PENDING'),
    'statusLabel', COALESCE(a.status_label, 'Awaiting Punch')
  ) AS "todayAttendance"
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN attendances a ON a.employee_id = e.id AND a.date = CURRENT_DATE
WHERE e.id <> '{{ $json.callerId }}'
ORDER BY e.is_active DESC, e.role DESC, e.id ASC;
` }}
